hint.isekai_mahou.market.open: Market: list items for Guild coins. They sell even while you are offline; pick up the money under Collect.
hint.isekai_mahou.market.quest_board: Sneak and click a Quest Board to open the player Market.
hint.isekai_mahou.market.party: Party: kill XP is shared with nearby members, and your friends show a green marker and appear on the minimap. /p talks to the party only.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.sort_tip: Click to change the list order.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.empty: No listings yet. Open "Sell" and be the first!
market.isekai_mahou.ui.buy_tip: Buy for %s coin(s). Click again to confirm.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.cancel_tip: Removes the listing; the item returns to you.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.sell.pick: Click an item in your inventory to list it.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.sell.need_price: Type the total price, in coins.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.sell.none: You have no listings. Each one stays %s days on the Market; when it sells, the fee is %s%%.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.box.how: When someone buys one of your items, the coins wait here, even if you are offline. So do cancelled or expired items and anything that did not fit in your inventory.
market.isekai_mahou.ui.box.balance_tip: The balance also pays for your Market purchases.
market.isekai_mahou.msg.expired: Your listing of %s expired. The item is under Collect.
market.isekai_mahou.msg.collected_part: Collected: %s and %s item(s). The rest did not fit in your inventory.
market.isekai_mahou.msg.login_sold: [Market] While you were away: %s sale(s), %s waiting under Collect (menu, Market tab).
market.isekai_mahou.msg.login_waiting: [Market] Items or coins are waiting for you under Collect (menu, Market tab).
market.isekai_mahou.err.moved: The item moved in your inventory. Pick it again.
market.isekai_mahou.err.bad_price: The price must be between 1 and %s coins.
market.isekai_mahou.err.market_full: The Market is full right now.
market.isekai_mahou.err.no_money: Not enough coins: it costs %s and you have %s.
market.isekai_mahou.err.box_full: Your collection box is full: collect the items first.
